Convection.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

Concussion.text: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

Elemental Warding.text: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 3%.

Reverberation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

Call of Flame.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 5%.

Elemental Devastation.text: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 3% for 10 sec.

Elemental Focus.text: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Elemental Alacrity.text: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.17 sec.

Improved Fire Nova.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 10% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

Eye of the Storm.text: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 23%.

Call of Thunder.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

Elemental Reach.text: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 3 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 8 yards.

Lightning Overload.text: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 3% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Earthbound.text: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

Elemental Fury.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 20%.

Lava Burst.text: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 150 to 192 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

Earth's Grasp.text: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

Thundering Strikes.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

Guardian Totems.text: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

Mental Dexterity.text: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 33% of your Intellect.

Improved Ghost Wolf.text: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 1.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Improved Lightning Shield.text: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

Elemental Weapons.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

Shamanistic Focus.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

Anticipation.text: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 2%.

Flurry.text: Increases your attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Stormstrike.text: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Spirit Weapons.text: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Mental Quickness.text: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 15% of your Intellect.

Improved Stormstrike.text: When you Stormstrike, you have a 50% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 50% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

Maelstrom Weapon.text: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Rage of the Farseer.text: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

Improved Healing Wave.text: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

Totemic Focus.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

Mindfulness.text: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Natural Grace.text: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 5%.

Tidal Focus.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 1% and improves your chance to hit by 1%.

Improved Reincarnation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 2%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

Ancestral Healing.text: Increases your target's armor value by 8% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

Healing Focus.text: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

Water Shield.text: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expend

Tidal Mastery.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1%.

Restorative Totems.text: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 10%.

Mana Tide Totem.text: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Healing Way.text: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 8%.

Nature's Swiftness.text: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Purification.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 2%.

Riptide.text: Heals a friendly target for 485 to 533, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.
